subject.title: skill safe-encryption-skill: Spec Prohibits File Output But CLI Tool's Standard Interface Is File Output

question: Should ClawHub require publisher correction, hide or otherwise moderate safe-encryption-skill, or update scanner/content policy for this live encryption-guidance contradiction?
rationale: A repository patch cannot directly edit the third-party SKILL.md, and the remaining decision affects hosted security guidance and marketplace moderation boundaries.

options.title: Request publisher correction
options.body: Ask the publisher to republish SKILL.md with clear final-output versus temporary-file rules, then recheck the scan/moderation status.

options.title: Hide pending correction
options.body: If reviewers judge the ambiguity too risky for a live encryption skill, hide the listing with an auditable moderation note until corrected.

options.title: Broaden scanner policy
options.body: If this pattern should be caught across skills, update scanner/content policy after defining the exact contradiction rule to avoid overblocking normal encrypted file output.

recommendation.title: Request publisher correction
recommendation.body: Ask the publisher to republish SKILL.md with clear final-output versus temporary-file rules, then recheck the scan/moderation status.
